title: Virtualized transcript redesign: one position authority, explicit attachment state, no residency assumptions
outcome:
GREG 2026-07-30: 'keep fixing it. This is bigger change of virtual session redesign.' Commit held deliberately; this is a redesign, not a patch queue.

WHY AN EPIC RATHER THAN MORE BUGS: five defects surfaced in this area in one day and every one traces to the same three confusions, not to five independent mistakes. Patching them individually is why we keep finding a new one after each fix.
- tm-hna: the bounded WIRE projection inherited from a metadata-only builder and dropped pendingPrompts.
- tm-1q1: the working-turn hint rediscovered the current prompt by scanning the transcript, which became a 20-message window.
- tm-9sf.1: jump-to-start scrolled to the top of the loaded window instead of fetching the true start.
- tm-9sf.2: two disagreeing definitions of 'bottom' with two writers, one lacking a deadband.
- tm-9sf.3: 'at the bottom of the loaded window' was treated as 'attached to the live tail', so a historical window presents as live and appends vanish silently.
Root confusions: (1) more than one authority for scroll position, (2) attachment state inferred from geometry rather than held explicitly, (3) features rediscovering state by scanning whatever happens to be loaded.

INVARIANTS THE REDESIGN MUST ESTABLISH. Each is derived from a defect actually observed, not invented:

I1. ONE POSITION AUTHORITY. Exactly one code path writes transcript scrollTop; everything else requests through it. Today writers live in at least two files — ui/src/panels/VirtualizedConversationMessageList.tsx (:380) and ui/src/SessionPaneView.scroll.ts (:280, :317, :358, :410, :459, :816, :843, :876). Any second writer can and will disagree. Evidence: two upward writes landing on the identical stale value 11458 while the true bottom was 11703/11825.

I2. ONE DEFINITION OF BOTTOM: the real DOM bottom (scrollHeight - clientHeight). Estimates may inform WHICH ROWS RENDER; they must never be written to scrollTop. Codex already removed the estimated writer; the surviving estimate at :659/:674 is acceptable only because it feeds visiblePageRange and nothing else. Keep that boundary explicit or it will erode.

I3. ATTACHMENT IS EXPLICIT STATE, NEVER INFERRED FROM GEOMETRY. scrollTop === maxScrollTop must never be read as 'following the live tail'. Model at least three distinct states: AttachedToTail, DetachedRecent (user scrolled up, newest loaded), ViewingHistory (older page loaded, hasNewerHistory true). tm-9sf.3 is exactly the cost of collapsing the first and third.

I4. NO FEATURE MAY DEPEND ON TRANSCRIPT RESIDENCY. State the UI needs continuously — current prompt, current command, first-message identity, counts, timestamps — is carried as an explicit field or fetched deliberately. It is never rediscovered by scanning the loaded window. tm-bv7 holds the audit; known survivors are session-store.ts:519 collectLastResponseTimestamp(session.messages) and composer promptHistory. My own verification probe tripped over this too: it identified a pane by searching the DOM for a marker, and virtualization evicted the marker.

I5. AN UNRENDERED APPEND MUST BE ANNOUNCED. In any state where a new message is not appended to the visible list, a visible affordance must say so. Silence is a defect, and it is the specific reason tm-9sf.3 is P0 rather than cosmetic: deviation 0 plus a live activity card under stale content reads as a current transcript.

I6. PROJECTIONS NARROW FROM FULL, NEVER BUILD UP FROM SUMMARY. Bounded wire responses start from the complete projection and remove what they must, so a newly added field cannot be silently lost. Codex already did this in wire_session_tail_from_record; make it the stated rule and apply it to the remaining projections (tm-hna.1).

I7. MEASUREMENT MUST NOT MOVE A PINNED VIEWPORT. Height re-measurement, page-height resolution and authority transitions are invisible to a pinned user. Sub-two-frame lag between an append and the follow-write is acceptable and must not be 'fixed' — I measured 7 such excursions recovering in 12-25ms and they are unavoidable.

SEQUENCING: tm-9sf.3 (P0) first — until it is fixed, any bottom-pin measurement is invalid because the pane can sit at deviation 0 inside a historical window. Then instrument for tm-9sf.2 per its notes. tm-bv7 and tm-hna.1 are the residency and projection sweeps. tm-2q8 is an independent decision, not a blocker.

TESTING RULE FOR THIS EPIC: assertions must distinguish the states above. 'Ends up near the bottom' passes with tm-9sf.2 present. 'Hint renders' passes with tm-1q1 present given a fixture window. 'pendingPrompts is an array' passes with tm-hna present. Every test here must fail against the pre-fix code — verify that it does.

VERIFIED-WORKING BASELINE not to regress: tm-hna, tm-1q1 and tm-9sf.1 are confirmed live (wire probe with a real queued prompt; rendered AGENT COMMAND card in a 1748-message session; Ctrl+Shift+Up reaching the true first message with a real history fetch). Gates green independently: cargo check 0, 1462 Rust tests, tsc 0, 157 vitest files. Freeze fingerprint at verification: headCommit=9546580623a962402d0f059908c3b9c55ed22755.

I8 (ADDED 2026-07-30 after tm-7cu.1 re-verification). EVENTS MUST BE OBSERVED, NEVER RECONSTRUCTED FROM DERIVED STATE. Three defects today share this shape: 'the user just sent a prompt' inferred from visibleLastMessageAuthor === 'you' (tm-7cu.1 - a history navigation rewrites the resident window and fires a spurious prompt-send reattach), 'the pane is following the live tail' inferred from scrollTop === maxScrollTop (tm-9sf.3), and 'the current turn's prompt' inferred by scanning the transcript (tm-1q1). Derived state is mutated by unrelated features, so any event reconstructed from it fires at the wrong time. If the product knows an event happened - a composer submit, a keypress, an append - pass that signal explicitly.
